y-m-10-01.title: Yisiphi isigodi esinabantu abaningi?
y-m-10-01.topic: Ukuqhathanisa izinombolo ezinkulu (inani lamadijithi, bese uqhathanisa kusukela endaweni ephakeme kakhulu)
y-m-10-01.goal: Chaza ukuthi usayizi unqunywa kanjani uma izinombolo zinamanani ahlukile amadijithi, nokuthi idijithi lendawo yiliphi elinquma umphumela uma zinenani elifanayo lamadijithi. Nquma ukuthi yini odinga ukuyazi ukuze uqhathanise uma idijithi ifihliwe.
y-m-10-01.material: Ufuna ukuqhathanisa inani labantu abahlala eGaram Village (가람마을) neNarae Village (나래마을). Izinombolo ezikuphawu zonke ziyizinombolo zemvelo, zibhalwe ngekhoma (,) ngemuva kwamadijithi amathathu ngamunye, futhi idijithi lokuqala alisilo u-0. Iyunithi ngu-'명' (abantu).
y-m-10-01.thinking.0: Nquma ukuthi ulwazi lwanele yini ukuqhathanisa
y-m-10-01.thinking.1: Chaza, usebenzisa umshwana othi uma-bese, ukuthi kungani siqhathanisa kusukela endaweni ephakeme kakhulu
y-m-10-01.prereq.0: Izindawo zamanani nokufunda izinombolo ezinkulu kuze kufike ezigidini (izinga lebanga 4)
y-m-10-01.prereq.1: Ukufunda izinombolo ezibhalwe ngamakhoma ngemuva kwamadijithi amathathu ngamunye
y-m-10-01.s.s1.prompt: Okokuqala, icala lapho wonke amadijithi ebonakala. Yisiphi isigodi esinabantu abaningi?

y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.a: Ubheke ukuthi amadijithi okuqala makhulu kangakanani. Hlola ukuthi indlela efanayo isebenza kokubili uma izinombolo ezimbili zinenani elifanayo lamadijithi nalapho zinamanani ahlukile amadijithi.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.b: I-Narae Village. I-Garam Village inenombolo yamadijithi ayisithupha futhi i-Narae Village inenombolo yamadijithi ayisikhombisa

y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi izinombolo azikwazi ukuqhathaniswa uma amaqembu amakhoma ehlukile. Amakhoma ayizimpawu kuphela ezenza izinombolo zifundeke kalula. Cabanga ukuthi yini enquma usayizi wenombolo.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Ezinombolweni zemvelo ezinedijithi lokuqala elingeyona u-0, enamadijithi amaningi mkhulu. U-987,654 uyinombolo yamadijithi ayisithupha futhi u-1,000,000 uyinombolo yamadijithi ayisikhombisa. Noma amadijithi angaphambili u-9, 8, 7 abonakala makhulu, akusizi. Ungahlola nalokhu ngoba ukwengeza u-12,346 ku-987,654 kunika u-1,000,000.

y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.d: Noma ungazi u-□, qhathanisa indawo yabodwa: u-8 we-Garam Village mkhulu kuno-0 we-Narae Village, ngakho i-Garam Village inabaningi
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.d: Uqhathanise kusukela endaweni ephansi kakhulu. Cabanga ukuthi yiyiphi indawo okufanele uyibheke kuqala lapho uqhathanisa izinombolo ezinkulu.

y-m-10-02.title: Impendulo kaSeoa: singayethemba?
y-m-10-02.topic: Ukuhlola umphumela we-(inombolo yamadijithi amathathu)×(inombolo yamadijithi amabili) (ukulinganisa, idijithi labodwa, ukuhambisana kwezindawo)

y-m-10-02.material: Incwadi yamanothi eyodwa ibiza 347원. Ukuze athole intengo yezincwadi zamanothi ezingu-23, uSeoa wenza ukuphindaphinda okuqondile futhi wabhala impendulo engu-1,735원. Ungabona ukubala kukaSeoa esinyathelweni sesibili. Okokuqala, ngaphandle kokuphinda ubale, cabanga ukuthi le mpendulo ingathenjwa yini.

y-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zama ukushintsha u-347 no-23 babe yizinombolo eziseduze ngamakhulu namashumi, noma ubheke ukuthi umkhiqizo wamadijithi athile unquma idijithi labodwa lomkhiqizo.

y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.d: Njengoba u-7×3=21, idijithi labodwa lomkhiqizo kufanele libe ngu-1, kodwa u-1,735 uphela ngo-5
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.d: Usebenzise isakhiwo sokuthi idijithi labodwa lomkhiqizo linqunywa ngumkhiqizo wamadijithi abodwa.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.explain: U-b no-d bafinyelela esiphethweni esifanayo (akusiyo u-1,735) ngezindlela ezihlukile. U-b uhlola usayizi futhi u-d uhlola idijithi labodwa. y-m-10-06.topic: Ukubala ngokweqa ngezinombolo ezinkulu nemikhawulo yokubikezela ngomthetho
y-m-10-06.goal: Bikezela inombolo elandelayo kurekhodi elibala ngokweqa ngo-100,000, kodwa bonisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi amarekhodi ambalwa awakwazi ukukwenza kube 'ngokuqinisekile', bese uhlukanisa isibikezelo nokuqiniseka.
y-m-10-06.material: Ipaki yokuzijabulisa irekhode inani labahambeli inyanga ngayinye. Amarekhodi abhalwe kuphela ngamayunithi abantu abangu-10,000, ngakho ahlala eyizikhathi zika-10,000. Januwari ingabantu abangu-3,420,000, Febhuwari ingabantu abangu-3,520,000, futhi Mashi ingabantu abangu-3,620,000. UMina uthe, “Iyanyuka ngabantu abangu-100,000 ngenyanga, ngakho u-Ephreli ngokuqinisekile uzoba ngabantu abangu-3,720,000!”
y-m-10-06.thinking.0: Ukunquma ukuthi isibikezelo esisekelwe emthethweni siqinisekile kangakanani
y-m-10-06.thinking.2: Ukubhala isibikezelo nesimangalo esiqinile njengezinto ezihlukile
y-m-10-06.prereq.0: Ukufunda nokubhala izinombolo ezinkulu ngamayunithi eziqubu eziyikhulu nezigidi (ibanga leBanga 4)
y-m-10-06.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umcabango ofaneleke kakhulu ngalokho okushiwo nguMina?
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.0: Thola ukuthi inyuke ngabantu abangaki kusuka kuJanuwari kuya kuFebhuwari nakusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuMashi.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga isimo esisodwa lapho u-Ephreli ebengaba nenani elihlukile (isibonelo, isimo sezulu noma umcimbi), bese ucabanga ukuthi amarekhodi kuphela angakutshela lokho yini.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.a: Cishe abantu abangu-3,720,000 kuyisibikezelo esijwayelekile, kodwa inani elihlukile lingavela
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde umthetho emarekhodini futhi wahlukanisa isibikezelo nokuqiniseka.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.b: Abantu abangu-3,720,000 kulungile ngokuqinisekile. Ngoba inyuke ngo-100,000 ezinyangeni zonke ezintathu
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.b: Ngeqiniso lokuthi kwakufana kathathu, wenze isiphetho sokuthi kuhlale kunjalo. Cabanga ukuthi ikhona yini ubufakazi bokuthi kuzofana nasikhathini sesine.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.c: U-Ephreli awukwazi ukwaziwa nhlobo. Amarekhodi amathathu okuqala awanamsebenzi ekubikezeleni
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.c: Ulahle wonke amarekhodi angaphambilini. Cabanga ukuthi angumkhondo womthetho yini.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.d: Kubonakala sengathi kungabantu abangaba ngu-3,620,000, kodwa kungase kungalungi
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.d: Ukhulume ngokucophelela, kodwa awusebenzisanga inani lokunyuka elingafundwa emarekhodini.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuthi inyuke ngo-100,000 ezinyangeni ezintathu kungumkhondo wokuthi kungenzeka inyuke ngenani elifanayo no-Ephreli nawo. Kodwa inani lokunyuka ku-Ephreli lingahluka, ngakho awukwazi ukusho 'ngokuqinisekile'. Ukulahla wonke amarekhodi (c) noma ukungawunaki umkhawulo wokunyuka (d) nakho akuyona into ebikezela kahle.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amarekhodi abonisa ukuthi 'ngokuqinisekile' kukaMina kungaba yiphutha. NgoJanuwari, Febhuwari, noMashi inani lenyuka ngo-100,000 ngayinye, futhi ku-Ephreli akungu-100,000 ngaphezu kukaMashi. Wonke amarekhodi ayizinombolo ezinezinombolo eziyisikhombisa, futhi uJanuwari no-Ephreli bangamaphindeke ka-10,000. Yenza amarekhodi amabili anezinguquko ezihlukile ku-Ephreli.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gcina izinyanga ezintathu zokuqala zifana nesibonelo, bese ucabanga ngenani lika-Ephreli elingeyona u-100,000 ngaphezu kukaMashi.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ngemva kokukhetha inani lika-Ephreli, hlola ukuthi umehluko noMashi akungu-100,000 nokuthi liyisikhathi sika-10,000.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Amarekhodi kumele abe yizinombolo ezinezinombolo eziyisikhombisa kusukela ku-1,000,000 kuya ku-9,999,999.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c2: UJanuwari no-Ephreli kumele babhalwe ngamayunithi abantu abangu-10,000 (amaphindeke ka-10,000).
y-m-10-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Inyuke ngabantu abangu-100,000 kusukela kuJanuwari kuya kuFebhuwari.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c3: UFebhuwari kumele abe ngu-100,000 ngaphezu kukaJanuwari.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Inyuke ngabantu abangu-100,000 kusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuMashi.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c4: UMashi kumele abe ngu-100,000 ngaphezu kukaFebhuwari.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.ok.c5: Ku-Ephreli ayinyukanga ngabantu abangu-100,000. 'Ngokuqinisekile' kukaMina kuyaphuka.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c5: U-Ephreli ungu-100,000 ngaphezu kukaMashi ncamashi. Khona amazwi kaMina alungile ncamashi.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, 3,420,000 → 3,520,000 → 3,620,000 → 3,730,000 inyuke ngo-100,000 ezinyangeni ezintathu zokuqala bese inyuka ngo-110,000 ku-Ephreli. Irekhodi elehlayo, njengo-5,100,000 → 5,200,000 → 5,300,000 → 5,250,000, nalo lisibonelo esiphikisayo. Uma ngisho nerekhodi elilodwa elinjalo likwazi ukwenzeka, amarekhodi ezinyanga ezintathu kuphela awakwazi ukwenza u-Ephreli abe 'ngokuqinisekile' into ethile.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.prompt: Ungabikezela kanjani inani labantu ku-Ephreli? Bhala inombolo oyibikezelayo nesizathu, futhi ubhale ukuthi yini ongadinga ukuyazi kakhulu ukuze usize uma isibikezelo sakho singaba yiphutha.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.hint.0: Beka amarekhodi owenzile ku-s2 eceleni kwamarekhodi amathathu angempela, bese ubona ukuthi u-Ephreli ubengahluka kanjani emarekhodini afanayo kuze kufike kuMashi.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ngesimo esisodwa lapho isibikezelo sakho singaba yiphutha, bese ubhala ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi ongadinga ukuluyazi ukuze usazi.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Ngibikezela ukuthi u-Ephreli uzoba cishe ngabantu abangu-.... Ngoba ...
y-m-10-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi inombolo oyibikezelile yavela kanjani emarekhodini?
y-m-10-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe amagama akho abonisa ukuthi isibikezelo sakho 'sicishe', hhayi 'ngokuqinisekile'?
y-m-10-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe lokho ongathanda ukukwazi kakhulu kuyinto ethile engashintsha isibikezelo sakho?
y-m-10-06.s.s3.model.0: Ngibikezela ukuthi u-Ephreli uzoba cishe ngabantu abangu-3,720,000. Lokho ngoba inyuke ngo-100,000 inyanga ngayinye kusukela kuJanuwari kuya kuMashi. Kodwa imicimbi noma isimo sezulu ku-Ephreli kungase kube kuhluke, ngakho ngingadinga ukwazi kakhulu ngalokho ukuze ngiqiniseke.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.model.1: Ngiqagela cishe abantu abangu-3,720,000, kodwa angikwazi ukusho ukuthi kunjalo ngokuqinisekile. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi inani elifanayo lengezwa izinyanga ezintathu, kodwa u-Ephreli ungase ushintshe ngokuhlukile. Uma ngabe ngiphinde nginerekhodi likaMeyi, ngabe ngingakholwa kakhulu emthethweni.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Akwenzi isibikezelo sibe yisimangalo esiqinile, futhi kusho ngokukhethekile ukuthi yimaphi amarekhodi engeziwe adingekayo.
